Your setup is done. Now for the part that makes it last: small, regular resets so slouching never gets the chance to settle in.

Today's 3 habits

The 20/20 reset
Every 20 minutes, take 20 seconds to re-check your posture.
Reset in three moves
Sit tall, roll your shoulders back and down, tuck your chin slightly.
Stand every 60–90 minutes
Get up, stretch, walk, grab water. Movement is medicine.
